storyHeading: Industrial components, made with care in Ghaziabad
story:
Established in 2023 at the Rajinder Nagar Industrial Area, Ghaziabad, Jugnu Roshni Pvt. Ltd. is engaged in manufacturing and supplying a wide variety of industrial components. Our range includes turned components for the switchgear and automobile industries, sheet metal components, press tools, and elevator components and accessories. We also offer industrial fabrication services to customers across the country. The company is led by promoters with more than 10 years of experience in component manufacturing.

Our products are made by diligent professionals using quality raw material obtained from established vendors. Customers value our components for their durable finish, precision engineering, corrosion resistance and dependable performance — and we provide customised solutions to the technical specifications shared with us.
